MIND. [1] [Cinnb.]
Indisposition for mental labor.
Sensation of fulness of head from mental application.
Forgetfulness (forgets things he has to do.)
Fretful, easily provoked, irritable.
Desire to be alone.
Mind clear and cheerful.
Exhilaration.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Cinnb.]
Dizziness : in morning after rising ; when stooping ; with nausea.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Cinnb.]
Dulness and heaviness of head, with ringing in ears after dinner and late in evening.
Fulness in head ; eyes are reddened.
Congested sensation over whole head, principally forehead.
Congestion of blood to head, particularly to vertex ; < after eating.
Sensation as if touched by a cold metallic body, on a small space over root of nose.
Feeling like a vise or band around head, cutting, shooting pain in forehead, aching in superciliary ridge of right eye, extending to back of head, with nausea.
Pressing in forehead with sensation of congestion.
Dull pain in forehead, which is cold ; > by heat.
Tearing pain in forehead, before catamenia.
In morning, after waking, pain in forehead and top of head ; < when lying on left side and back ; > and going off when turning on right side, and after rising.
Dull pain in left temple and side of head.
Shooting pain in left side of head, with increase of saliva and great flow of urine.
Pain from back of head to forehead with vertigo, cannot grasp ideas ; shooting from occiput forward.
Intense headache ; cannot raise his head from pillow ; > by external pressure.
Headache with nosebleed.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Cinnb.]
The bones of skull, the scalp, and even the hair are painfully sensitive to touch.
Tensive, stinging pains in ears, cheeks, temples and sides of head, extending to occiput and nape of neck, with swelling of parotids and face. θ Catarrh of bladder.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Cinnb.]
Dimness and opacity of cornea.
Marked photophobia and lachrymation, with redness.
Redness of whole eye, with swelling of face.
Shooting pains through eye into head.
Sharp, stitching, stinging, or dull, aching pain above eye, extending from internal to external canthus, or runs around eye ; pain may extend into eye or up into head.
Inflammation of right eye ; itching, pressing and pricking at inner angle and lower lid ; constant lachrymation on looking steadily, with profuse discharge of mucus from nose.
Shooting pains in inner canthus of right eye, with burning and itching.
Outer half of left eye injected and puffy ; pains severe, seeming to run around the eye, < at night.
Sticking pain about punctum lachrymale of upper eyelid.
Lids so heavy that they are kept open with difficulty, < in evening.
Asthenopia, with pain extending from inner canthus around eye, with soreness over exit of supraorbital nerve, < in morning.
Conjunctivitis and blepharitis, discharge < in morning.
Kerato-iritis and uncomplicated iritis, especially in syphilitic variety, and if condylomata are present on iris, or on lids ; < at night ; pain intermitting.
Keratitis.
Soreness along course of supraorbital nerve and corresponding side of head, < at night.
Ciliary neuralgia.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Cinnb.]
Roaring in ears, with swelling of face (after eating).
Scurfy eruption in right external ear.
Itching in right ear.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Cinnb.]
Sensation on bridge of nose similar to that produced by touching it with a metallic substance.
Uneasy creeping and pressive sensation about ossa nasi, lasting about an hour ; the sensation experienced by most persons on putting on a pair of heavy spectacles, if not accustomed to wear them.
Sensation of weight and pressure at root of nose, zygoma and temples. θ Catarrh.
Itching of nose, with bleeding (very dark blood) after blowing it.
Coryza, with lameness of thighs and aching pain in small of back ; lumps of dirty yellow mucus are discharged from posterior nares.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Cinnb.]
Hot face, which is much swollen, mostly about eyes.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Cinnb.]
Corners of mouth chapped.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Cinnb.]
Right molars and bicuspids (some decayed) feel soft, heavy, and too large, at 8 P. M. and at 2 or 3 A. M. ; sensation comes and goes gradually.
On biting teeth together, second right upper decayed molar feels as if it would fly to pieces.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Cinnb.]
Taste : metallic ; bitter (in morning), putrid.
Tongue coated white in morning.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Cinnb.]
Soreness in roof of mouth.
A small ulcer on roof of mouth, on right side of tip of tongue.
Salivation ; increased flow of saliva and of urine. θ Inflammatory affections of mouth and fauces.
Inflammation with great dryness in mouth and throat, < at night, which causes him to drink often.
Dryness and irritation of throat at night, with soreness in morning, secretion of tenacious mucus during day, inclination to empty deglutition.
Scanty, tenacious, pasty saliva in mouth, without thirst ; > after drinking.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Cinnb.]
Inflammation, with great dryness of throat and mouth ; < at night.
Contracting pain in throat during empty deglutition.
Fulness in throat causing a constant desire for swallowing.
Dryness and irritation of throat (posterior nares, tonsils, fauces) at night, with soreness during day ; in morning, secretion of tenacious mucus, in lumps, from posterior nares.
Increased dryness of throat and mouth, being obliged to moisten and rinse mouth every time he wakes.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Cinnb.]
Want of appetite with aversion to food.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Cinnb.]
After eating, great discomfort and feeling of distension and pressure in upper abdomen, with flushes of heat.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Cinnb.]
Nausea : with waterbrash ; alleviated by eructations and vomiting.
